# Libraries the pdf-minify package for Debian 13 (trixie) carries itself,
# because Debian's version is too old (python3-pymupdf 1.25: no Brotli, and
# the app needs 1.28.2). Installed at build time with
# pip --require-hashes --only-binary into /usr/lib/pdf-minify.
# Everything else is a Depends in debian/control.
pymupdf==1.28.2 \
    --hash=sha256:397d6715c1f0df7548a92d0afd8ce370fc48fa47aeefac16be2bc04a16a8227f
